# Board: migrate every card file into one issue
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #74, sha256:929ad5c5ea2a32f99ccdf3e459a15dd74587cf6fa7b22f1732b6dbbe96ffb2f4). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Done 2026-10-26 (scripts/board/migrate_cards.py; 77 issues created, 12 closed, one per card file; verified by check_real_board.py --issues)
- **Type:** tooling (tooling (phrase-lang `scripts/board/`)); thin slice; authored by the driver rotation, reviewed by a non-author (D15), run atomically once card 062 exists (until then in a scratch clone), smoke-tested on a fake `gh` before any real apply
- **Milestone:** process: the board moves to GitHub Projects (the loop's source of truth)
- **Source:** product direction, 2026-10-26: move Phrase's board to a GitHub Projects board, as play-tracker has, so he can view it as a real board on their phone; decided before more loop cards are built on the file-based picker. Team design: Decider D25 (Codex, Copilot, Grok Yes; agy no response).
- **Depends on:** 073
- **Story:** As Steve, I want the Phrase board as a real GitHub Projects board, so that I can see and re-rank it on my phone, and as the mob I want the loop to read that board, so that there is one source of truth.
- **One observable behaviour:** Every card file becomes exactly one issue in phrase-lang titled `(NNN) <card title>`, with the whole card (Connextra story, criteria, Context, task force, `Depends on:`, Done when) as the body and a `<!-- phrase-card:NNN -->` marker, so the history stays linked.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given the board tests with a fake `gh` and fixtures, When the behaviour above is exercised, Then a dry run lists one issue per card file and changes nothing; the body is the card file after its title, verbatim, with no `.mob/` state, run logs, prompts or local paths
  2. Given the board tests with a fake `gh` and fixtures, When the behaviour above is exercised, Then applying creates one issue per card and a second apply creates nothing (idempotent by the marker); superseded and withdrawn cards are closed as not planned, Done cards as completed, nothing is deleted
  3. Given the board tests with a fake `gh` and fixtures, When the behaviour above is exercised, Then a real-board check counts the issues carrying a marker and finds exactly one per card number on the board

## Context

- Design (D25): Project v2 under Programming-Made-EZ named `Phrase Board`, PRIVATE (the product owner views it logged in on their phone; the issue text is already public in the repo; making the project public is a one-word ask for the product owner and the scripts have no public setting). Fields: Rank, Card number, Depends on, Kind, Phase, Card author, plus Status (GitHub reserves the names Type, Milestone and Author, found on the real apply) (Ready, In Progress, Done, Superseded/Withdrawn); the built-in close-sets-Done workflow is off. Tooling cards whose code runs in mob-defaults are still issues in phrase-lang. A card is Done only when its Done-when passes and a non-author reviewed it; a bare issue close never implies Done.
- Safety: the migration and picker scripts use only the `gh` token's `project`, `repo` and `read:org` scopes, against `Programming-Made-EZ/phrase-lang` and its ONE project; they NEVER delete issues, comments, items or the project, never edit an issue without the `<!-- phrase-card:NNN -->` marker, never change visibility, permissions, workflows or secrets, and never touch play-tracker, mob-defaults' GitHub repo or any other mob; the default is `--dry-run`, apply refuses any other owner or repo, and a second apply creates nothing; each card is smoke-tested on a fake `gh` before any real apply.
- Phrase board and docs (read-only, absolute paths): cards in `C:\Users\ringe\projects\phrase-lang\board\`, `VISION.md` and `docs\` under `C:\Users\ringe\projects\phrase-lang\`.
- Tests first with the fake `gh`; Windows and PowerShell quoting traps apply (write scripts to files, no nested quoting).
